_published_faq.name: How do I add Virtual Fly Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Virtual Fly Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://vfb3-mcp.virtualflybrain.org/.

_published_faq.name: Is Virtual Fly Brain MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Virtual Fly Brain scores 78/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Virtual Fly Brain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virtual Fly Brain provides these MCP tools: get_term_info, run_query, and search_terms.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Virtual Fly Brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Virtual Fly Brain in healthcare on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aniva, ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN), Health Data Avatar (HDA), KORE, and PubCrawl.

_published_faq.name: Does Virtual Fly Brain MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virtual Fly Brain does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Virtual Fly Brain is developed by Virtual Fly Brain. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
